verdict.rationale: Claude Design can generate full visual designs from a text prompt and offers layout/color adjustment sliders (claude-design-docs-13, claude-design-docs-9), which loosely maps to 'image generation' and some asset tuning, but there is no evidence of dedicated background-removal, content-aware fill, or copy-suggestion tools built into the editor. missing for 10: background removal tool, content-aware fill/inpainting, in-editor copy/headline suggestion feature.
